paragraphs: Zone & Co’s ERP‑native AI platform tackles the pain of siloed financial data in NetSuite – I’ve built LLM agents that turn raw data into actionable insight, just as your teams need real‑time intelligence.

I built a tool‑calling LLM agent with LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, adding three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Azure yet.
